instruction: An intimate studio portrait photograph, captured in a close-up shot at eye level. In a minimalist indoor photo studio with a seamless white background, the red-haired woman in the blue shirt (R2) is on the left, leaning her head close to her friend's head and looking directly at the camera with a bright, happy smile. Beside her on the right, the curly-haired woman in the green crop top (R1) stands close to her friend, looking directly at the camera with a warm, joyful smile. The red-haired woman (R2) rests her chin on her hand, which is placed on the curly-haired woman's (R1) right shoulder, as their heads touch. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting with soft shadows, creating a clean white and pastel color palette.
elements: R2 places her hand on R1's right shoulder
R2 rests her chin on her own hand while that hand is on R1's shoulder
R2 leans her head close to R1's head
R1 stands close as the shoulder-contact recipient beside R2
R1 and R2's heads touch in the close portrait
minimalist indoor studio with a seamless white background
